hypothesis: Day-2 follow-through add-ons already have positive marginal expectancy, but production forgets unexecuted ADD advice. If an operator bought conservatively or skipped the add-on, the next advice cycle should keep the prior ADD visible until open_positions shares reconcile.
why_not_direct_alpha_change: Recent add-on experiments showed the valid surface is add-on budget/reservation, while raw heat-cap changes, same-day ordering, and volume confirmation were rejected. This experiment changes only execution memory for already code-decided ADD actions.

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260508-017: Removing add-on heat cap improved EV but was rejected as an unsafe production policy; points to preserving confirmed-winner add-on intent without weakening hard risk caps.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260508-018: Same-day add-on ordering had no effect; the issue is not queue order.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260508-026: Checkpoint volume confirmation rejected; do not add another add-on trigger filter.
historical_experiment_check.mechanism_insight: Do not retry heat-cap increases, same-day ordering keys, or volume confirmation. This is an execution-memory repair, not a trigger retune.

single_causal_variable: pending_actions ledger now tracks ADD add_on_trades in addition to REDUCE/EXIT position_actions

baseline_metrics.recent_quant_addon_audit_pattern: 2026-05-04 through 2026-05-08 addon_actions were empty and addon_audit reasons were all not_checkpoint_day.

new_coverage: ADD add_on_trades are registered with expected_remaining_shares = original_shares + shares_to_buy.
Unexecuted ADD advice is reinserted into add_on_trades with decision_mode=pending_unexecuted_action.
ADD pending records close when open_positions shares reach expected_remaining_shares.
Existing REDUCE/EXIT pending behavior remains covered.
after_metrics.reason_ev_not_rerun: No signal generation, ranking, sizing, add-on trigger, heat cap, stop, target, universe, LLM veto, or backtester execution policy changed.

production_impact.scope: Only repeats an already code-decided ADD until broker/open_positions share count shows it executed.

risk: If open_positions is stale, an ADD may be repeated even after execution. The reconciliation guard closes it as soon as shares are updated, so operator discipline around open_positions remains required.
next_action: Add an explicit intended/original signal share field to open_positions for conservative-entry top-up analysis, then run a separate replay to test whether top-up-to-intended shares improves EV without changing add-on triggers.
